title: Office Depot Recalls Desk Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The weld connecting the seat plate to the gas lift can fail, causing the chair to separate from the base. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: 307,000 in the United States and 12,000 in Canada.

title: Public Bikes Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The pedals can crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 4,100.

title: Todson Recalls Bicycle Child Carrier Seats Due to Laceration and Fingertip Amputation Hazards
summary: A child can place his or her fingers in the opening at the grab bar's hinge mechanism. When the consumer lifts the grab bar to remove the child from the seat, the child's fingertips can be caught in the hinge mechanism, posing a laceration and fingertip amputation hazard to the child. Units: About 4

title: West Elm Recalls Folding Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs can collapse during normal use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000 in the United States and 100 in Canada.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Grass and Hedge Trimmers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Fuel can leak from the rubber spacer holding the fuel lines in the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,500 grass trimmers and 6,500 hedge trimmers.

title: Irwin Recalls 10-Inch Circular Saw Blade 3-Pack Due to Laceration Hazard Posed by Defective Packaging
summary: The saw blades can fall out of the bottom of the plastic packaging, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 55,260.

title: Sakar International Recalls Battery Chargers Due to Electrocution, Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The plastic holding the screws can break, causing the screws to come loose and the casing to separate. This can expose energized components, exposing users to electrocution or electric shock. Units: About 48,000.

title: XS Scuba Recalls Miflex High Pressure Diving Hoses Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The diving hose can rupture reducing the available air supply to the diver, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: Air Rifles Recalled by Air Venturi Due to Ability to Fire With Safety Switch On
summary: The safety switch can be overcome by pulling the trigger with force, allowing the rifle to fire, resulting in a serious injury or death. Units: About 100.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bike Brake Levers Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The adjuster cap and brake cable can slide out of position and make the brakes non-operational. This can cause a rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Units: About 600.

title: STOK Gas Grills Recalled by One World Technologies Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The regulator on the grill can leak propane gas, which can ignite, posing fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 87,600 in the U.S., 1,400 in Canada.

title: Additional Fire Incidents Prompts Baja Motorsports to Reannounce Dirt Bike Recall
summary: The fuel tank can leak, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,300 (This recall was first announced in March 2011).

title: GT, Giant and Trek Bicycles with SR Suntour Suspension Forks Recalled by SR Suntour Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The suspension fork's internal support tubes can break and cause the rider to lose control, fall and crash. Units: About 17,000.

title: Nan Far Woodworking Recalls to Repair Drop-Side Cribs Due to Entrapment, Suffocation and Fall Hazards; Sold Exclusively at JcPenney
summary: The cribs' drop sides can malfunction, detach or otherwise fail, causing part of the drop side to fall out of position, creating a space into which an infant or toddler can roll and become wedged or entrapped, which can lead to strangulation or suffocation. A child can also fall out of the crib. Dro

title: Club Car Recalls Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake pedal mounting blocks can crack and separate, resulting in a loss of braking ability, resulting in a crash. Units: About 100.

title: Viking Range Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the dishwasher can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Gerber Recalls Instant Knife Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The locking mechanism on the spring-assisted blade can fail to engage properly, causing the blade to fold during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury, Death Hazard
summary: The recalled products have been incorrectly labeled as having a higher occupant capacity than is safe. Operating the vehicle with additional occupants creates an injury or death hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Manhattan Group Recalls Baby Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The clear spheres on each end of the rattle can break, releasing small parts, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 3,000 in the United States and 150 in Canada.

title: Target Recalls Bunny Sippy Cups Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The ear on the bunny sippy cup can poke a child in the eye area while using the cup for drinking, posing an injury hazard. Units: Approximately 264,000.

title: Gems Sensors Recalls Pressure Transducers Used in Fire Pump Controllers Due to Risk of Failure in a Fire
summary: The transducer can fail to accurately detect water pressure in a fire suppression sprinkler system. This could cause the sprinkler system to fail to activate and pump water to the sprinklers in the event of a fire. Units: About 25,000.

title: Girls' Jackets Recalled by Louise Paris; Waist Drawstrings Pose Entanglement Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Ross Stores
summary: The jackets have drawstrings at the waist that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors and pose an entanglement hazard to young children. Units: About 13,000.

title: Lenovo Expands Recall of ThinkCentre Desktop Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A defect in an internal component in the power supply can overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000 (50,500 were previously recalled in March 2012).

title: Youth Jacket Recalled by PUMA; Waist Drawstrings Pose Entanglement Hazard
summary: The jacket has a drawstring at the waist that has toggles and is not stitched to the back of the jacket. The drawstring could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors and it poses an entanglement hazard. Units: About 5,000.
